prompt: We passed basic Cyber Essentials last month. What happens in the Plus audit and what trips people up?
assertions: States the timing rule: CE Plus must be completed within 3 months of the basic certification

Describes the audit content: internal (authenticated) and external vulnerability scans, a random sample of user devices (roughly 10%, covering build types), all internet gateways and internet-reachable servers, plus malware and email/browser download defence tests

Notes the current retest rules: a failed sample triggers a retest with a NEW random sample, and a second failure revokes the verified self-assessment certificate; answers can't be adjusted once testing begins
Lists realistic failure causes: unpatched high/critical vulnerabilities on sampled devices, missing MFA, local admin misconfigurations, unsupported software discovered in scope
Notes CE+ is individually quoted (not the fixed basic-tier pricing) and can be remote or on-site
